reason: A DSH Web UI plugin focused on responsive mobile layout, touch-friendly controls, drawer navigation, settings navigation, and mobile-oriented content presentation through CSS and lightweight event listeners.

summaries.zh: 通过响应式样式和轻量交互脚本优化 DSH Web UI 在手机端的布局、触控操作、侧边栏、设置页及消息展示。
summaries.en: Improves the DSH Web UI on mobile devices with responsive styling and lightweight interaction scripts for touch controls, navigation, settings, and message presentation.

capabilities: Injects CSS into the DSH Web UI
Adds lightweight event listeners for mobile navigation interactions
Adjusts responsive layout, typography, controls, sidebars, settings pages, messages, statistics, and tables
